dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I can't work anymore. What am I going to do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your job?

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I am... Uh, I used to be a clerk in 5th Finances Office at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I was at the Maison Gestion discussing the delivery of some reports when the institute blew up. So I was lucky enough to, you know... not get blown up...

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: But our office and all our financial reports were blown to smithereens.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I mean, it's not bad news. But it's not good news, either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's your job?

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: Hello, Honorary Senior Researcher. I'm so happy to see you...

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I used to be a clerk in 5th Finances Office at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I was at the Maison Gestion discussing the delivery of some reports when the institute blew up. So I was lucky enough to, you know... not get blown up...

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: But our office and all our financial reports were blown to smithereens.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I mean, it's not bad news. But it's not good news, either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I need to keep working on the financial reports.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why isn't it bad news?

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: Because... There used to be numerous projects running at the Fontaine Research Institute, and each one would always be applying to purchase this or that resource. The volume was simply enormous.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: In accordance with regulations, all purchases and expenses had to be recorded in detail in financial reports so we could carry out an end-of-year audit.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: But most of the researchers didn't care much about following proper procedures for applications or records. The info they submitted was always a mess, mistakes and missing items everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: The end-of-year audits never managed to completely settle all the accounts. And that meant we had to empty the filing cabinets in search of receipts and order forms... It was chaos.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: But the explosion destroyed all that paperwork. Which means this year I'll be able to relax for once...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you also said it's not good news?

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: Because... Hahaha, I'm now the only accountant able to work!

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: Rebuilding the Fontaine Research Institute is going to mean buying lots of materials. How am I meant to cope with all that accounting work on my own...

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: Oh, I'll just have to pray the reconstruction work goes slowly. Or that I can find a competent assistant...
